definition.name: Released binaries without a Rust toolchain

steps.name: Authenticate the exact released native archive
steps.run:
mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/frontend-release"
gh release download 0.1.0-alpha.5 --repo KirilsTurkins/latent-service-fabric --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/frontend-release" --pattern lsf-0.1.0-alpha.5-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz --pattern release.json --pattern SHA256SUMS --pattern SHA256SUMS.sigstore.json
gh attestation verify "$RUNNER_TEMP/frontend-release/SHA256SUMS" --bundle "$RUNNER_TEMP/frontend-release/SHA256SUMS.sigstore.json" --repo KirilsTurkins/latent-service-fabric --cert-identity https://github.com/KirilsTurkins/latent-service-fabric/.github/workflows/native-runtime-release.yml@refs/tags/0.1.0-alpha.5 --cert-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com --source-ref refs/tags/0.1.0-alpha.5 --source-digest f6d8f32177208b60a68f14070f549f927052dd48 --signer-digest f6d8f32177208b60a68f14070f549f927052dd48 --deny-self-hosted-runners --predicate-type https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1 --digest-alg sha256 --format json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/frontend-release/authentication.json"
python3 tools/static-release/unpack.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/frontend-release" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/frontend-release/archive-verification.json"

steps.name: Build the bounded frontend qualification environment
Check signing identities and hostile approvals
steps.run: docker run --rm --cpus 1 --memory 256m --pids-limit 32 --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --mount "type=bind,source=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE,target=/source,readonly" lsf-frontend-qualification --test /source/tools/static-release/evidence.test.mjs

steps.name: Exercise actual signing, OCI and native publication
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
container=$(docker create --label io.latent.frontend-qualification="$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" --cpus 2 --memory 2g --pids-limit 128 --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=536870912,mode=1777 --mount "type=bind,source=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE,target=/source,readonly" --mount "type=bind,source=$RUNNER_TEMP/frontend-release/extracted,target=/release,readonly" lsf-frontend-qualification /source/tools/static-release/qualification.mjs /release/bin/latent /tmp/result.json /release/bin/latentd)
[[ "$container" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
cleanup() { docker rm --force "$container" >/dev/null; }
trap cleanup EXIT
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 180s docker start --attach "$container" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/frontend-release/qualification.json"
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.ExitCode}}' "$container")" = 0
cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/frontend-release/qualification.json"

reviewReason: Lossless sharding of the reviewed v1 inventory; owner fingerprints remain enforced.
